M: Leo wants his order right this time

Two smashed beef patties with melted American cheese, onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce on a toasted soft bun, wrapped in paper. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls of 100g. Heat a heavy pan or flat grill until smoking. Add a ball, smash it flat with a spatula and season. Cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip, top with a slice of cheese and cook 1 minute more. Toast 4 buns cut side down. Stack two patties on each bun with finely diced onion, sliced pickles, mustard and tomato sauce, then wrap tightly in baking paper for 2 minutes to steam.
Grilled boerewors sausage in rolls with tomato chili relish
Coiled boerewors (or thick spiced beef sausage) grilled over coals, in rolls with tomato and onion relish (onion, tomato, chilli and a little sugar simmered 20 minutes).
W: Vanilla cupcakes with swirled pastel buttercream and sprinkles
Vanilla cupcakes with swirls of pastel buttercream and sprinkles, the brightest ones you can make.
K: Roger's ginger and lime lager shandy
Cold lager topped with ginger beer and fresh lime over ice

Cold lager topped with ginger beer and fresh lime over ice in tall glasses, garnished with lime wheels and a sprig of mint. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze half a lime into each. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass, then top with 150ml ginger beer and stir gently once. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a sprig of mint. Serve straight away while it's still fizzing.

Pile on a board with the dried peaches and macadamias in little bowls.

Simmer with the sugar into a relish.

Cut the boerewors and serve in rolls with relish.

Bake the cupcakes.
Cool on a rack.
Beat the butter with the icing sugar and tint in pastel colours.

s.note: Thin double-fried fries, salted hot, drive-thru style.
s.how: Cut 1kg russet potatoes into thin fries, soak 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, drain and cool, then fry again at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp. Toss with fine salt and serve in paper bags. Check the order before you leave.

s.note: Thin biltong with dried peaches and salted macadamias
s.how: Roast 150g macadamias at 170C for 8 minutes and toss with salt while warm. Slice 250g biltong thinly across the grain. Pile on a board with 150g dried peaches and the macadamias in little bowls.

m.note: Grilled spiced sausage coil in rolls with tomato and onion relish
m.how: Simmer 2 sliced onions, 4 chopped tomatoes, 1 chilli and 1 tsp sugar for 20 minutes into a relish. Grill a 1kg coil of boerewors over coals or a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning once. Cut and serve in 4 long rolls with relish.

w.note: Bright vanilla cupcakes with pastel buttercream and sprinkles
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint in pastel colours, swirl on and add sprinkles.
